description_en: ✨ Premium Apartment 1+1 for sale - May 5 | Near the "Adrian Klosi" school ✨ In one of the most sought-after areas of May 5, near the "Adrian Klosi" school, a 1+1 apartment is for sale in a new building of 2025, built with modern standards and equipped with 2 elevators. 🏢 Floor: 4th living 📐 Gross area: 55.23 m² 📐 Net area: 68.5 m² The apartment offers a very functional organization and ample spaces: Living room + kitchen with natural lighting Comfortable bedroom Large toilet Balcony with access from the hall and the bedroom, ideal for relaxation ✅ Finished with high quality work ✅ Ready for furnishing ✅ Natural lighting and ventilation ✅ Suitable for both comfortable living and safe investment 📍 Strategic location, near schools, institutions, services and transport lines. 💰 Price: €135,000 (disputable) 📞 For more information or to visit the property, contact us!
